annotation_policy: No bulk annotation; preserved unchecked pilot records are not evaluation labels; reviewed layer is agent-assisted, not human review
interpretation: Original accuracy uses separate held-out targets. Edited-scenario customer outcomes are unknown; no counterfactual customer accuracy or conclusive faithfulness score.

price_policy.comparison_basis: canonical rounded decimal amounts; displayed equal prices compare equal
price_policy.currency_assumption: Supplied numeric prices are assumed USD dollar amounts for this experiment

registry.applicability: Complete current prices, positive cent-valued alternative inside development bounds; otherwise skip.
registry.must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
registry.purpose: Price sensitivity: preserved or reversed cheapest set
registry.selection_rule: Zero-based selected-case index even: existing preserve-cheapest rule; odd: existing reverse-cheapest rule. Preserve: first candidate with a +1/-1-cent edit preserving the entire cheapest set. Reverse: first noncheapest candidate set one cent below the minimum. All edits remain inside the frozen development bounds. No substitution if infeasible.

registry.applicability: At least one known current flag.
registry.must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
registry.selection_rule: Toggle the lexicographically first candidate with a known flag.

registry.applicability: Known support purchase and at least two candidates.
registry.must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
registry.purpose: Household-history sensitivity including dependent purchase-offer relations
regenerate: counts, shares, most frequent, historical price and advertising relationships
registry.selection_rule: First support ID; replace purchase with next candidate in sorted cyclic candidate order.

registry.applicability: 2..8 complete support records; changed association with same eligible denominator; otherwise uninformative.
registry.must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
registry.purpose: Change price-purchase association at fixed purchase counts
regenerate: per-record cheapest/gaps and historical price aggregates
registry.selection_rule: Enumerate vector permutations; deduplicate unordered visible records; maximize absolute change in purchased-among-cheapest numerator, then lexicographic assignment.

registry.applicability: 2..8 known support records with varying flag vectors and changed association; otherwise skip.
registry.must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
registry.purpose: Change advertisement-purchase association at fixed purchases
registry.selection_rule: Enumerate vector permutations; deduplicate unordered visible records; maximize absolute change in purchased-advertised numerator, then lexicographic assignment.

registry.applicability: At least one provided historical offer field.
registry.must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
registry.purpose: Remove historical offer context while retaining purchases
regenerate: all historical offer relationships and exclusions; counts preserved
registry.selection_rule: Set all historical offer values to null; retain support IDs and purchases.

registry.must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
regenerate: all compact facts rerendered in presentation order
registry.selection_rule: Rotate candidate presentation one position left; preserve answer mapping.

registry.applicability: At least two candidates; bijection verified.
registry.must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
registry.purpose: Answer-label assignment sensitivity, decoded by product
regenerate: all compact facts regenerated under consistent relabeling
registry.selection_rule: Rotate sorted answer identifiers one position left across fixed product identities; remap every current/support candidate field.

sampling_policy: One joint response per applicable original/edit; no unchanged reruns or repeated sampling; do not automatically continue to remaining test cases
selection_rule: Seeded round-robin across test households; independently seed-shuffled actual query records within each household; exhausted households omitted from later rounds; no outcome-based filtering
